messages:
tom_finance: Heads-up: customer SkyForge reported unexpected $720 in burst charges on INV-2026-412 during a planned tenancy eviction on 2026-07-08. They insist their reserved commit should have covered the window. Can ops confirm meter attribution before we offer any SLA credit?

ivy_ops: Checking timeline. There was an eviction at 09:03 UTC that triggered session handoffs. Some sessions spilled into shared backfill because the eviction coincided with our hourly billing boundary and the commit lease expired mid-session. Looks like commit tag was present at start but not reattached after handoff.

claire_recon: Can you paste the invoice line ids or raw meter rows so I can match to INV-2026-412 lines 9-12? Need cents to draft memo.

ivy_ops: Extract (trimmed):
```
line_id,customer,commit_id,region,usage_sec,charge_cents,tag
L09,skyforge,commit-SF-5,us-east-1,0,0,reserved
L10,skyforge,commit-SF-5-temp,us-east-1,3600,36000,burst
L11,skyforge,commit-SF-5,us-east-1,1800,36000,burst
```
The two burst lines sum to 72000 cents = $720. L10 shows temp suffix from reissued node; L11 looks like the billing boundary charged a continued session as on-demand.

nate_sales: Customer escalated to AM. Their expectation: no overage for planned eviction with <5 min drain. We have an internal policy to issue provisional credit when it's our lease/eviction logic at fault. Finance, what's acceptable provisional cap?

tom_finance: Finance can provisionally credit up to $750 (GL 6110 - Customer Credits) pending reprocess. Need ops to run a targeted reprocess with lease-rejoin tag merge and dedupe to ensure we don't double-credit. Also need a short customer message draft.

ivy_ops: I'll queue reprocess: `ops-billing reprocess --customer skyforge --start 2026-07-08T08:50Z --end 2026-07-08T09:30Z --merge-lease-tags --dedupe`

billing-bot: Job queued: br-20260708-303. ETA ~5m.

claire_recon: Creating provisional memo PC-2026-499 for $720 (status=pending-reprocess) referencing INV-2026-412 and br-20260708-303.

billing-bot: br-20260708-303 completed: "2 meter rows reclassified to reserved, 1 duplicate removed, invoice re-aggregation scheduled (agg_id: agg-20260708-15)"

claire_recon: Re-agg posted. Final invoice shows the $720 overage removed; outstanding balance $0. I'll void the provisional memo and note resolution.

tom_finance: Thanks, team. I'll notify AM: "We reprocessed usage after identifying lease/eviction tag propagation gap during your planned eviction; all burst charges have been removed and no credit is required." Close after AM confirmation.
